start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:build-a-best-x-for-y-comparison." For one category (X) and one buyer (Y) the person names: find the vendors buyers and answer engines weigh; choose only metrics a vendor can prove at a public address and read every value with its address and date; score the vendors with a vendor proof row of rules (tools/workflows/read-data/candidate-rules.json, classified by tool:classify-a-record), where a metric with no proof never counts; write a page whose quotable answer, structured comparison table (each cell linked to its proof), method and FAQ are in the served HTML with ItemList and FAQPage data, so answer engines can quote and cite it; keep sponsored placement in its own labelled block that never changes a score or a rank; publish only what the person approved, check it the way answer engines read it, hand it to workflow:keep-pages-cited-by-answer-engines and recheck the proof on a schedule.
no_lists_because: The item names no list in its own words, input or steps, so it has no example rows to ship.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Run workflow:build-a-best-x-for-y-comparison" with the input in the worked example.
2. The AI starts it with tool:start-a-recipe-run (row workflow:build-a-best-x-for-y-comparison) and works through its steps in order: scope, metrics, gather-proof, score, page, publish, keep-cited.
3. Read what each step hands back; the last step is keep-cited.
